n-anakin-skywalker-coins.summary: Coins named for a headline that went viral on X from 2026-10-31: "Experts are concerned that Anakin Skywalker is becoming a symbol of right-wing extremism." Anakin Coin (ANAKIN, Pump.fun) repeats it as its description: "Anakin Skywalker is becoming a symbol of right-wing extremism". Two Anakin Skywalker coins (Anakin, Pump.fun) have no description; their name is the subject of the headline. Posts of 2026-10-31 from the Morse Report (16:06 UTC, about 4.7M views) and of 2026-11-02 from Leading Report (03:05 UTC, about 865K views) carry the headline (e1:8); none of the posts names an outlet or links a source article, and the headline is not checked here. Dates from Codex: the pools of the two Anakin Skywalker coins opened on 2026-10-29 (ExxzYB...) and 2026-11-02 06:00 UTC (DB71Yy...), and the ANAKIN pool on 2026-11-01 22:28 UTC. The first headline posts are dated 2026-10-31, so the ExxzYB... coin (token created 2026-10-29 17:45 UTC, pool 19:28 UTC; daily volume $250,101 on 2026-10-30, $3,368,097 on 2026-10-31) predates them and did not launch on the story. The descriptions are the coins' own; none of the coins is shown to be connected to any person, studio or campaign.
